answer: An agent market grants one bid per hour for each 100 tokens locked for 30 days, not merely for opening an account. Whether an agent buys a quill, maps a dune, or rents a lantern, extra identities gain no free bidding capacity: each needs its own bond. A thousand active aliases therefore immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, imposing financing and opportunity costs even if every bond is eventually returned.
